verdict.rationale: Claude Code has extensive first-party documentation on connecting MCP servers (stdio, HTTP transports), with concrete examples like `claude mcp add --transport http notion` and use cases (Jira, Slack, Google Drive, Postgres, Figma) demonstrating tool use once connected. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration specifically of MCP tool usage (community evidence covers other aspects of the product, not MCP integration itself).
